pages.title: CRM Dashboard
pages.shortSummary: Main CRM dashboard with overview and navigation
pages.longSummary: The primary dashboard providing a comprehensive overview of CRM activities, key metrics, and quick navigation to all major CRM functions. Shows real-time statistics and provides centralized access to all CRM tools.

pages.title: Unified Email Inbox
pages.shortSummary: View and manage all received emails across all accounts
pages.longSummary: Unified inbox that aggregates emails from all connected email accounts. Features include reading emails, composing replies, filtering by account and customer, smart threading, and multi-recipient handling. Supports Reply and Reply All with automatic signature insertion.

pages.title: Bounce Suppression List
pages.shortSummary: View and manage email addresses blocked due to bounces
pages.longSummary: Displays all email addresses that have been identified by AI as bounced and added to the suppression list. The nightly scan runs at 2:30 AM MT and automatically adds new bounced addresses so they are never emailed again. Supports manual add/remove, run history, and an instant scan trigger.

pages.title: Decline Scanner
pages.shortSummary: Detect opt-out replies, mark contacts declined, and delete all their pending outreach
pages.longSummary: Scans received email replies for opt-out / decline requests ('take me off your list', 'we don't want to participate anymore'). Matching contacts are marked Declined in outreach_sets, added to the global opt-out list, and all of their pending outreach is deleted across every channel: scheduled emails, phone activities, and LinkedIn activities (HeyReach leads are stopped). Supports a manual back-scan of the last X months with a dry-run preview, plus an automatic daily scan at 6:45 AM MT covering the previous 3 days. Shows run history for both manual and automatic scans.

pages.title: Compose Email
pages.shortSummary: Compose and send emails from connected accounts
pages.longSummary: Standalone email composition tool for sending emails from any connected email account. Supports CC/BCC, automatic signatures, and proper email threading. Ideal for quick email sends without navigating the full inbox.

pages.title: Sent Emails
pages.shortSummary: View history of all sent emails
pages.longSummary: Complete archive of all sent emails across all accounts. View email content, recipients, timestamps, and delivery status. Filter by account, customer, and date range.

pages.title: Email Queue Management
pages.shortSummary: Manage and schedule email campaigns
pages.longSummary: Comprehensive email queue and scheduling system. Schedule emails for future delivery, manage drafts, preview emails before sending, handle email threading and replies, and monitor scheduled email status. Features pagination, test sending, and CID image embedding for better deliverability.

pages.title: Sent Email Database
pages.shortSummary: Comprehensive database of all sent emails with advanced search
pages.longSummary: Full searchable database of all sent emails. Advanced filtering by customer, account, date range, and content. View detailed email information including HTML content, recipients, and threading information. Track email sending patterns and history.

pages.title: Email Frequency Monitor
pages.shortSummary: Monitor email sending frequency and compliance
pages.longSummary: Track and monitor email sending frequency across accounts to ensure compliance with daily limits and prevent spam flags. View sending patterns, check account health, and get alerts when approaching limits. Essential for maintaining good email deliverability.

pages.title: Send Monitoring Dashboard
pages.shortSummary: Real-time email sending monitoring and statistics
pages.longSummary: Real-time monitoring dashboard for email sending activities. Track emails being sent, view success rates, identify failures, and monitor overall system health. Provides alerts and notifications for sending issues.

pages.title: Add Lead
pages.shortSummary: Add new leads and contacts to the CRM
pages.longSummary: Comprehensive form for adding new leads to the CRM system. Capture contact information, company details, lead source, notes, and initial outreach preferences. Supports custom fields and automatic data validation. Starting point for all new prospect relationships.

pages.title: Interested Contacts Worklist
pages.shortSummary: Manage interested prospects requiring follow-up
pages.longSummary: Focused worklist of prospects who have shown interest. Filter and sort by customer, interest level, last contact date, and next steps. Track follow-up activities, set reminders, and manage the sales pipeline for engaged prospects. Essential for converting interest into meetings.

pages.title: Hotsheet Prospecting Dashboard
pages.shortSummary: Main prospecting interface for viewing and working leads
pages.longSummary: Primary prospecting dashboard showing all active leads in a comprehensive grid view. Filter by customer, status, campaign, and custom criteria. Quick actions for emails, calls, and status updates. Navigate through prospects efficiently with pagination and sorting. Central hub for day-to-day prospecting work.

pages.title: Mail Campaign Hotsheet
pages.shortSummary: Specialized hotsheet for email campaign leads
pages.longSummary: Dedicated hotsheet view optimized for managing email campaign prospects. Track email sequences, response rates, and follow-up timing. Bulk actions for email sending and campaign management. Specialized filters for email-specific metrics and statuses.

pages.title: Outcomes & Status Updates
pages.shortSummary: Record call and email outcomes for leads
pages.longSummary: Comprehensive outcome tracking system for recording results of outreach activities. Log call outcomes, email responses, meeting statuses, and next steps. Track win/loss reasons, schedule follow-ups, and maintain detailed activity history for each lead. Critical for measuring conversion rates and pipeline health.

pages.title: Scheduled Meetings
pages.shortSummary: View all meetings scheduled through Outcomes
pages.longSummary: Comprehensive view of all meetings that were marked as 'Successful/Scheduled' in the Outcomes page. See meeting date/time, who it's with (BDR/team member), contact method, and contact details. Filter by customer, campaign, and time period (past, today, upcoming). Essential for tracking all scheduled meetings and ensuring follow-through on outreach success.

pages.title: My Leads
pages.shortSummary: Personal view of leads assigned to you
pages.longSummary: Personalized dashboard showing only leads assigned to the current user. Track your personal pipeline, see your upcoming tasks, and manage your assigned prospects. Filtered view that helps individual BDRs focus on their specific workload.

pages.title: LinkedIn HeyReach Manager
pages.shortSummary: Manage LinkedIn campaigns via HeyReach integration
pages.longSummary: Central management interface for LinkedIn outreach campaigns using HeyReach. Create campaigns, manage connection requests, schedule messages, track responses, and monitor LinkedIn activity. Full integration with HeyReach API for automated LinkedIn prospecting.

pages.title: HeyReach LinkedIn Inbox
pages.shortSummary: Manage LinkedIn messages and conversations
pages.longSummary: Inbox for all LinkedIn conversations from HeyReach campaigns. View message threads, send replies, track conversation history, and identify interested prospects. Categorize conversations and flag for follow-up. Essential for managing LinkedIn engagement at scale.

pages.title: HeyReach Leads
pages.shortSummary: View and manage leads from LinkedIn campaigns
pages.longSummary: Comprehensive view of all leads generated through HeyReach LinkedIn campaigns. Track connection status, message sequences, response rates, and engagement levels. Filter by campaign, status, and activity. Export leads and sync with CRM.

pages.title: HeyReach Activity Log
pages.shortSummary: Activity timeline for LinkedIn campaigns
pages.longSummary: Chronological activity feed showing all LinkedIn actions: connection requests sent, messages delivered, profile views, replies received, and campaign events. Filter by date, campaign, and activity type. Audit trail for LinkedIn outreach efforts.

pages.title: HeyReach Data Cleanup

pages.longSummary: Administrative tool for cleaning up HeyReach data. Remove duplicates, resolve data conflicts, archive old campaigns, and maintain data quality. Bulk operations for data management and optimization.

pages.title: HeyReach Sync Manager

pages.title: HeyReach Contact Removal

pages.longSummary: Bulk removal tool for removing contacts from HeyReach campaigns. Handle opt-outs, remove unresponsive contacts, and manage campaign exclusions. Maintain compliance and campaign hygiene.

pages.title: LinkedIn Schedule Manager
pages.shortSummary: Schedule LinkedIn outreach activities
pages.longSummary: Scheduling tool for LinkedIn campaigns and outreach activities. Set up connection request schedules, message sequences, and automated follow-ups. Configure timing, frequency, and campaign pacing. Essential for scaling LinkedIn outreach while maintaining authenticity.

pages.title: Phone Campaign Inbox

pages.title: Call Assignments

pages.title: Scheduled Calls
pages.shortSummary: View and manage scheduled phone calls
pages.longSummary: Calendar view of all scheduled phone calls and callbacks. See upcoming calls, reschedule appointments, and set reminders. Integrates with outcomes system for post-call logging. Never miss a scheduled conversation.

pages.title: Phone Schedule Manager

pages.title: Review & Approval

pages.title: Review Schedule
pages.shortSummary: Schedule reviews and approval workflows
pages.longSummary: Configure and schedule review processes for campaigns. Set up approval chains, define reviewers, and automate review reminders. Track review status and history. Ensures consistent quality control across all outreach activities.

pages.title: Team Performance Dashboard
pages.shortSummary: Track team metrics and performance
pages.longSummary: Comprehensive team performance analytics dashboard. View individual and team metrics including emails sent, calls made, meetings booked, and conversion rates. Leaderboards, trends, and goal tracking. Charts and visualizations for performance monitoring. Essential for team management and motivation.

pages.title: Revenue Goal Tracking

pages.title: Reports & Analytics

pages.title: Performance Monitor

pages.title: Research Assignment

pages.title: LinkedIn Extractor Results
